subject: Re: Grind frontmatter readiness -- results
body:
FP,

Ran: node scripts/frontmatter-readiness.cjs --target grind --json from C:\GitHub\journal

Results:
  Total Grind markdown files: 68
  With frontmatter: 2
  Ready (all 7 required keys): 0
  Missing frontmatter: 66 files

Required fields the script checks: id, name, description, owner, status, created, updated

Finding: Grind docs (C:\GitHub\kai-algebra2-tests\docs\) are operational agent docs -- onboarding, protocol, agent status, publish runbooks. They don't use the Forge/journal frontmatter schema. This is by design -- these are markdown spec files, not journal entries or skill records.

The 2 files with frontmatter are likely legacy files from before the schema was standardized.

Recommendation: Do NOT apply the 7-key schema to Grind docs. The frontmatter-readiness.cjs script is calibrated for journal/Forge docs. If you need a Grind-specific readiness check, define a Grind frontmatter schema (agent docs might want: title, agent, status, updated at minimum).

I can build a Grind-specific frontmatter lint if you define the required fields. Let me know.

- GF
